refusals.reason: Angular, vanilla-browser and other renderers require their own adapter gates.
Dynamic, promised or multi-configuration build exports require one precise manual composition and are not mutated automatically.
Multiple roots or an existing React boundary require one precise manual composition before setup can be ready.
Multiple conventional process entries require an explicit application entry and are not modified.
Unknown output directories require a reviewed postbuild uploader command.
Callback-style invocation completion is outside the promise.
Streaming response completion is outside the promise.
Only promise-returning asynchronous handlers are wrapped automatically.
AWS Lambda, Vercel, Netlify, Google Cloud and Azure remain candidate presets until each lifecycle is independently conformed.
Vue SSR, Nuxt, multiple roots and dynamic createApp composition are outside the Vite client promise.
SvelteKit, SSR, hydration, multiple roots and dynamic mount composition are outside the Vite client promise.
Fastify 4 is end-of-life and multiple or dynamic Fastify instances are not mutated automatically.
WebSockets, HTTP/2-specific behaviour, streaming, SSE and serverless completion require separate lifecycle gates.
Nest versions before 11 and GraphQL, gateways, microservices, hybrid or standalone application contexts are outside the HTTP promise.
Multiple applications, custom HTTP adapters and non-composable exception filters require an exact manual outcome before any mutation.
